verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no batch or bulk endpoints for adding, updating, or deleting many memories at once. The CLI covers per-memory add, search, list, update and delete. Memory Export (structured exports via Pydantic schemas) and expiration dates are adjacent features, not bulk operations across many items, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
